-- The screenshot shows "FOX 8-20 - PERFURATRIZ HIDRAULICA WOLF FOX8 -20" in DESMONTE DE ROCHA
-- Let's check what tag is stored in item_despesa_importado for this equipment
SELECT DISTINCT equipamentoTag, equipamentoDescricao, equipamentoSistemaId 
FROM item_despesa_importado 
WHERE periodoCustoId = 60001 
AND (equipamentoTag LIKE '%FOX%' OR equipamentoTag LIKE '%WOLF%' OR equipamentoTag LIKE '%PERFURATRIZ%')
LIMIT 10;
